text:
**Sunday**, a free day. Rest up, because the week ahead is a full one.

The Book Fair runs all week, with its grand event and the SHINE lunch on **Wednesday**. Your Unit 5 math quiz is expected around then too, so try a few long-division problems early in the week; your math shelf has a long-division warm-up for it. It is gear week at Tae Kwon Do, so wear all your gear to class.

**Friday** is the Costume Parade, so have your costume ready by Thursday night. It is a day about saying no to bullying, and about having fun together.
